chunks: Some of our companions asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام and said to him:
Should I begin with Mecca or with Medina?
He عليه السلام said to him: Begin with Mecca and conclude with Medina, for that is better.

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, the Imam عليه السلام being asked
key_terms.أَفْضَلُ: better or more excellent; indicating preferred merit
key_terms.ابْدَأْ: begin; an instruction to start there
key_terms.اخْتِمْ: conclude; an instruction to end there
key_terms.بِالْمَدِينَةِ: with Medina; the city with which one should conclude
key_terms.بِمَكَّةَ: with Mecca; the city from which one should begin

ai.seo_question: Should one begin with Mecca or Medina when visiting the two sacred cities?
ai.summary: This hadith gives guidance on the preferred order of visiting the two sacred cities. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام instructs that one should begin with Mecca and end with Medina, stating that this order is more excellent.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3140 - Some of our companions asked Abu Ja'far (as):
"Should I begin with Mecca or Medina?"
Imam (as) replied: "Begin with Mecca and conclude with Medina, for that is better."
